steps.name: claim
steps.artifact: the claim text and its declared scope

steps.name: repair/downgrade
steps.artifact: REPAIR_DELTA records or a downgraded claim ceiling

steps.name: architecture-prior audit
steps.artifact: the audit record, or a reason it does not apply

steps.name: independent implementation
steps.artifact: a second route sharing no code with the first

steps.name: frozen prediction
steps.artifact: a freeze committed before the outcome

steps.name: new-gap extraction
steps.artifact: one or more OPEN_GAP records extracted in this iteration

after_last_step: repeat (decision REPEAT) or stop (decision STOP with a declared stop reason)

status_rules.S12_NEW_GAP_EXTRACTION: must be DONE and the iteration must extract at least one gap

materiality_input_rule.severity: CRITICAL if, realised, it reverses a recorded verdict of a flagship result; MAJOR if it can reverse a recorded closure grade or gate verdict of the graph; MINOR if it affects identity or bookkeeping only; INFO otherwise
materiality_input_rule.evidence_mode: FINITE_EXACT if its extent is an exact count in the receipt, else ASSERTED
materiality_input_rule.scope: FLAGSHIP if it touches a flagship result; SECTION if it spans more than one package; PACKAGE if within one; else LOCAL
materiality_input_rule.blast: number of graph nodes whose grade or gate verdict it can change, capped at 3
